_about: Prepaid electricity ledger for meter 07147738442 (1A Welgemeend, includes Ansie's dwelling). Add every token (date, rand, kwh from the SMS/app) and any meter reading. The latest reading is the anchor; balance = reading + tokens bought after it - grid import since (inverter lifetime counter). Readings need the inverter's import total at that moment: tell Claude the reading and it fills that in. Alerts go to GitHub issues and to Werner's WhatsApp via Tannie.

tariff._note: Incl VAT. Matches the tokens: first R2,500 in a month = 600 + 77.7 kWh, a second one = 533 kWh (all block 2).
